newsitem.title: USA: Guilford's Gliadel Wafer brought to market.
newsitem.headline: Guilford's Gliadel Wafer brought to market.

text.p: Guilford Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Tuesday that its Gliadel Wafer, the first brain cancer treatment to deliver chemotherapy directly to the tumor site, is now commercially available nationwide.
Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc is marketing Gliadel Wafer, which is manufactured and was originally developed by Guilford.

The product was cleared by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in September of 1996 as adjunct to surgery to prolong survival in patients with recurrent glioblastoma multiforme for whom surgical resection is indicated.
Guilford shares traded up 1-1/2 to 26-1/4 in late morning trade.
